title: builders: 700+ tokens per second on deepseek r1 670b, for one user, with no speculative decoding ⚡
description:
builders: 700+ tokens per second on deepseek r1 670b, for one user, with no speculative decoding ⚡

openai detailed jalapeño at hot chips 2026. 216 gb of hbm4 at 15.4 tb/s, 13.4 petaflops of mxfp4, rated 700 watts.

nine months from first rtl to tape-out in november 2025. then they ran doom on it, and codex wrote the port.

it is not for sale. openai runs it themselves.

#hotchips #openai #doom
